observations: White split-system air conditioner with indoor and outdoor units.
The indoor unit is mounted on top of the outdoor unit.
The outdoor unit has a large circular grille and a handwritten 'inverter' label.
The indoor unit has a technical specification sticker on the front panel.
The exterior of the units shows significant dust and some surface wear.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a unit but does not demonstrate it is non-functional.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or heat effectively.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit running and reaching a set temperature.

risks.risk: The compressor or inverter may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with the compressor engaged.

risks.risk: The unit may be past its serviceable lifespan or have hidden mechanical damage.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the compressor and the interior of the condenser.

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on and cooling.
Photo of the technical specification sticker on the indoor unit to confirm the model and power rating.
Photo of the compressor and the interior of the outdoor unit.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
